items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: Interviewer mentions Charles Brown as a popular musician whose songs Ray Charles played; Interviewee does not claim any personal interaction or professional relationship with Charles Brown.

ctx.x: He had the best band in town. Now this is where my association with Ray Charles come. See, Ray Charles was the piano player in this band. And if you will remember the popular music at that time was uh, Charles Brown in the pop field and Louis Jordan in the pop field. OK, well this band played all their music, man.
